atom_description: Users need to configure security policies including trust mode, command allowlist, file access restrictions, and sandbox settings.
problem_statement: Users need to configure security policies including trust mode, command allowlist, file access restrictions, and sandbox settings.
scope_in: Trust mode picker (Review/Trusted/Sandbox); command allowlist tag editor; path restrictions; sandbox toggle
Implement SecuritySettingsView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Trust modes are predefined (Review, Trusted, Sandbox)
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Sandbox mode must be clearly warned
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
nonfunctional_requirements: Changes apply immediately to new sessions
Must not block the main UI thread.
implementation_steps: Add trust mode picker with descriptions
api_contracts: Primary API surface is the SecuritySettingsView.swift type and its public members.
Public APIs match Swift naming conventions and are documented in code comments.
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: Sandbox mode: Indicator that writes are disabled
ui_interactions: Select trust mode → Confirmation if Trusted
Click Reset → Defaults restored with confirmation
ui_copy: Descriptions: "Prompts for confirmation on risky actions", "Minimal gates for experienced users", "Read-only mode with safe tools only"
Warning: "Trusted mode reduces safety gates. Are you sure?"
edge_cases: Empty allowlist - all commands require approval
Glob pattern syntax error - show validation error
Reset while in Trusted mode - confirms twice
failure_modes: Invalid allowlist pattern - reject with error message
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Remove view; use hardcoded Review mode
